args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 (deployed to all production regions) is failing health checks with an elevated error rate (18%). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Monitoring post-rollback health.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

**Rollback**
- checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), failing health checks with an 18% error rate.
- Deployment history confirmed v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production (v2.3.1 was unhealthy; v2.3.1-rc was staging-only).
- Rolled back to **v2.3.0** in all regions. Verified: service is now healthy (error rate 0.2%) on v2.3.0 across all regions.

**Incident**
- Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** for checkout-api: "checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy", describing the unhealthy v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0, and that post-rollback health is being monitored. On-call was paged.

No approval was needed since this was a rollback to a previously healthy production version (not a new deploy).
